raw.title: Sales Development Representative (New Graduates)
raw.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR)

 

➡️ Ready to kick-start your career in sales, selling a best-in-class AI product you can genuinely be proud of?

➡️ Want to learn how to open doors, engage senior decision-makers and create opportunities with some of the world’s most innovative organisations?

➡️ Looking for a culture that rewards ambition, invests in your growth and offers exceptional training, uncapped commission and a clear path to becoming an Account Executive?

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

AI is changing how organisations research new technologies, evaluate ideas, understand competitors and decide where to invest. At Patsnap, we’re helping to lead that change.

We’re looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative to join our High Tech division and help drive the next stage of our growth.

As an SDR, you’ll be the first point of contact for prospective customers across a diverse range of industries. You’ll introduce senior R&D, Innovation, Engineering and Intellectual Property professionals to Patsnap’s AI-powered platform, start meaningful commercial conversations and create qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.

This is a proactive, high-activity outbound sales role. You’ll research potential customers, make cold calls, deliver personalised outreach and learn how to capture the attention of busy senior decision-makers. It takes confidence, resilience and consistency, but it also gives you the opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills quickly and see the direct impact of your work.

You don’t need previous sales experience to succeed here. We’re looking for curious, ambitious people who are eager to learn and prepared to put in the work. Through structured onboarding, regular coaching and close partnership with experienced Account Executives, you’ll build the skills and confidence needed to become a successful SaaS sales professional.

For someone who is competitive, motivated by personal growth and achievement who wants to build a career with that offers uncapped earning potential and a clear development path towards becoming an Account Executive and beyond, this could be the perfect opportunity.

With significant investment in AI, ambitious growth plans and a clear progression path, there's never been a better time to join Patsnap.

Want to see the platform you'd be representing?
Check out this short overview:

This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with the flexibility to work either hybrid (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday in the office) or fully office-based if you prefer.

 

Why This Opportunity?

Starting your sales career is about more than getting your first title. It is about finding the right environment to learn, build confidence and prove what you can achieve. At Patsnap, you’ll sell a sophisticated AI platform with a clear purpose and strong credibility in the market. You’ll receive structured training, practical coaching and daily exposure to experienced sales professionals who want to help you improve.

You’ll learn how to research accounts, communicate with senior stakeholders, handle rejection, uncover business challenges and create genuine commercial opportunities. As your capability grows, so will your responsibility, earning potential and opportunity to progress. You’ll also join a high-performing but low-ego team that shares ideas, supports one another and celebrates success properly.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust PatSnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

As an SDR, you'll be on the front line of Patsnap's growth, helping us connect with leading innovative organisations. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

You will:

  • Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn.

  • Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders.

  • Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations.

  • Build resilience by handling rejection positively and consistently achieving ambitious activity and pipeline targets.

  • Work closely with experienced Account Executives, helping convert qualified opportunities into revenue while learning every stage of the sales process.

  • Develop the commercial skills needed to progress into a closing role, including influencing, negotiation and relationship building.

  • Using your incredible communication skills to build brand new relationships between Patsnap and potential clients 

  • Working closely with an Account Executive, who will mentor and help to develop your sales skills, while you support their activity by creating sales leads and booking their product demonstrations 

  • Owning your territory and choosing which companies to call and will have the autonomy to be creative with how you introduce Patsnap to prospects 

  • Learning the necessary tools to be able to succeed in the role; what we ask of you is a can-do attitude and an open mind to learning 

  • Researching using varied and creative techniques to identify business opportunities (sales leads)


What We'd Love From You

You don't need previous sales experience – we're looking for people with the attitude, curiosity and ambition to build a successful career in tech sales. You could be starting your professional career, moving into sales from another sector or bringing some initial B2B sales or lead-generation experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A recent graduate (or early career professional) or has B2B sales or lead generation experience, ideally within the software industry (desirable) 

  • Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment.

  • Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people.

  • Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment.

  • Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career.

  • An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way.

  • Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve.

  • Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively.

  • Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery.

  • A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

Compensation:

  • Base Salary: £28,330 + uncapped commission

  • On-Target Earnings Total (OTE): £47,217 (60/40 split)

  • High achievers regularly exceed target, with earnings of £60k+

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

As an SDR, you'll be on the front line of Patsnap's growth, helping us connect with leading innovative organisations. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

You will:

  • Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn.

  • Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders.

  • Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations.

  • Build resilience by handling rejection positively and consistently achieving ambitious activity and pipeline targets.

  • Work closely with experienced Account Executives, helping convert qualified opportunities into revenue while learning every stage of the sales process.

  • Develop the commercial skills needed to progress into a closing role, including influencing, negotiation and relationship building.

  • Using your incredible communication skills to build brand new relationships between Patsnap and potential clients 

  • Working closely with an Account Executive, who will mentor and help to develop your sales skills, while you support their activity by creating sales leads and booking their product demonstrations 

  • Owning your territory and choosing which companies to call and will have the autonomy to be creative with how you introduce Patsnap to prospects 

  • Learning the necessary tools to be able to succeed in the role; what we ask of you is a can-do attitude and an open mind to learning 

  • Researching using varied and creative techniques to identify business opportunities (sales leads)


What We'd Love From You

You don't need previous sales experience – we're looking for people with the attitude, curiosity and ambition to build a successful career in tech sales. You could be starting your professional career, moving into sales from another sector or bringing some initial B2B sales or lead-generation experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A recent graduate (or early career professional) or has B2B sales or lead generation experience, ideally within the software industry (desirable) 

  • Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment.

  • Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people.

  • Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment.

  • Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career.

  • An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way.

  • Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve.

  • Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively.

  • Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery.

  • A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

Compensation:

  • Base Salary: £28,330 + uncapped commission

  • On-Target Earnings Total (OTE): £47,217 (60/40 split)

  • High achievers regularly exceed target, with earnings of £60k+

raw.title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are currently seeking an exceptional Senior Strategic Finance Analyst to join our Strategic Finance team. You can be based in either our Barcelona or London office.

The Strategic Finance department is responsible for crafting our long-term strategic roadmap and optimizing how we allocate resources to fuel our growth and create lasting value. Reporting to the Senior Director of Strategic Finance, you will be pivotal in shaping the company's operational plan and creating scalable business models. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you'll be instrumental in translating intricate operational goals into financial outcomes. Your keen analytical skills and effective communication abilities will be put to good use as you cultivate strong relationships throughout the organization. We aim to build a top-tier strategic finance team that prioritizes unwavering accountability. If you're ready to embark on this journey with us, read on!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of both short-term and long-term forecasting models, ensuring the leadership team has the data for precise decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with key cross-functional teams, in particular the go-to-market team, to gain insights into critical business developments that could impact future projections.

  • Support for the comprehensive planning and execution of both the long-term strategic plan and the annual operating plan.

  • Utilize an analytical approach to influence strategic decision-making, encompassing capital allocation and long-term financial planning choices.

  • Execute essential financial processes, including reporting, forecasting, budgeting, ROI-based resource allocation, and internal as well as external benchmarking.

  • Monitor crucial performance metrics and offer valuable insights through regular reporting and ad hoc analysis.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in investment banking, management consulting, or strategic finance/FP&A. Expertise or coverage of go-to-market functions within any of these roles is a bonus but not a must.

  • A track record of exceptional performance in demanding, high-calibre teams.

  • Data-driven mindset, a bias for rapid decision-making, favouring excellence over perfection.

  • Proficiency in Excel, including the ability to create and manage complex financial models.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools in analytical work - accelerating analysis, stress-testing assumptions, automating repetitive processes - and the judgment to know when human input is still essential.

  • Strong knowledge of financial statements, accounting principles, and investment analysis.

  • Capability to comprehend and collaborate with various lines of business.

  • Willingness to stretch beyond your comfort zone and embrace new challenges.

  • Openness to feedback, with a commitment to continuous improvement, development, and innovation.

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, or a quantitative field.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

raw.title: Event Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is on a mission to build the best-in-class operating platform for Residential Housing and transform disconnected systems into unified intelligence. Built specifically for housing, its unique multi-award-winning agentic AI platform converts the complexity of assets, contractors, compliance and resident interactions into unified, actionable intelligence.

Powered by the sector’s largest proprietary operations dataset, Plentific’s AI agents act, orchestrating processes and transforming property operations in real-time, helping owners, operators, service providers and residents streamline operations, unlock efficiencies and enhance the resident experience.

Its solutions span repair diagnostics, work order management, resident self-service, contractor and field service management, inspections and compliance. Acting as an integration layer, Plentific enables a real-time ecosystem and helps providers build resilient supply chains that prevent backlogs and ensure timely delivery of works.



The Role

The Events Marketing Manager at Plentific is responsible for developing and executing key marketing initiatives to drive client acquisition, networking and retention, and revenue growth. This role focuses on event planning, digital marketing execution and optimisation, and content creation, including website updates, email campaigns, and agency management. The Events Marketing Manager will lead internal and external events, webinars, partner marketing initiatives, and social media efforts while overseeing sales enablement and inbound marketing. Close collaboration with the commercial and product teams is essential to align marketing campaigns with business objectives and support revenue generation. The role reports to the Marketing Director and covers events across the UK and Germany.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute event marketing plans for physical and digital formats aligned with company objectives.

  • Own Plentific’s presence at sector conferences and exhibitions: sponsorship packages, stand design, speaker slots and on-site delivery.

  • Run Plentific’s own events end to end, from roundtables and client forums to flagship events, including guest lists, invitations and registrations.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage the event logistics, including venue selection, supplier management, stand design

  • Support the Marketing Director to brief and prepare internal speakers, and work with product marketing so event content reflects Plentific’s positioning.

  • Utilise online platforms to engage target audiences and drive attendance.

  • Create compelling event content such as blogs, sales collaterals, videos, promotional emails, and newsletters.

  • Build pre- and post-event journeys in HubSpot, and hand leads to sales quickly with clear follow-up actions.

  • Manage event budgets and timelines, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery.

  • Analyse event performance metrics (registrations, attendance, MQLs, MPLs, pipeline and opportunities influenced) and recommend improvements.

  • Stay updated on industry trends to enhance event marketing strategies.

  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of event landing pages with essential details.

  • Support the marketing team with social media, paid advertising, copywriting, and design tasks.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • An annual rolling events calendar agreed with marketing and sales leadership, with clear goals per event.

  • Consistent tracking of event ROI from registration through to pipeline in HubSpot and Salesforce.

  • At least two Plentific-owned events delivered from concept to follow-up.

Requirements

  • Strong analytical skills with proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Google Analytics, HubSpot reporting).

  • Excellent project management, prioritisation, and multitasking abilities for event planning and execution.

  • Strong communication, collaboration, and leadership skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

  • Strategic thinking, planning, and execution skills with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

  • Proficient in copywriting with a passion for creating engaging content.

  • Highly organised with excellent time management, adaptability, and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in your daily work to draft content, research audiences, plan logistics and analyse event results faster, with the judgement to check every output for accuracy and brand fit.

  • Curious about AI and able to bring Plentific’s agentic AI story to life at events, in a way that resonates with housing leaders.

  • Calm and confident on event days, able to solve problems on the spot.

Experience and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in event marketing roles, with a proven track record of driving significant client growth and revenue impact via events and digital campaigns.

  • Experience managing performance marketing campaigns across multiple channels, with a deep understanding of metrics, attribution models, and optimisation techniques.

  • Demonstrated success in scaling acquisition channels and delivering measurable business results in a fast-paced environment.

  • A deep understanding of targeting, client journeys, data-driven decision-making, and a passion for driving measurable results.

  • Experience with or willingness to learn tools like Canva, HubSpot CMS, Salesforce CRM, Payload for website and our marketing automation tools.

  • Willingness to travel within the UK

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, PropTech, housing or the public sector.

  • Experience running events with MPs, local authorities or senior sector stakeholders.

  • Nice to have but not mandatory : German language skills.

Benefits

As you can see, we are quickly progressing with our ambitious plans and are eager to grow our team of doers to achieve our vision of managing over 2 million properties through our platform across various countries. You can help us shape the future of Housing. Here’s what we offer:

  • A competitive compensation package

  • 25 days annual holiday + 1 additional day for every year served up to 3 years

  • Flexible working environment including the option to work abroad

  • Private health care for you and immediate family members with discounted gym membership, optical, dental and private GP

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Life insurance (4x salary)

  • Employee assistance program

  • Company volunteering day and charity salary sacrifice scheme

  • Learning management system powered by Udemy

  • Referral bonus and charity donation if someone you introduce joins the company

  • Season ticket loan, Cycle to work, Electric vehicle and Tech scheme programs

  • Pension scheme

  • Work abroad scheme

  • Company-sponsored lunches, dinners and social gatherings

  • Fully stocked kitchen with drinks, snacks, fruit, breakfast cereal etc.

raw.title: GTM Engineer
raw.description:
About Us

Plentific is redefining how property is managed in real time. Our cloud-based platform, supply chain and services help landlords run repairs, maintenance and compliance faster, with the data to make decisions instantly.

In the UK, we partner with housing associations and local authorities to tackle the sector's biggest challenges: repairs performance, disrepair, damp and mould, compliance and tenant satisfaction.

We're backed by world-class investors including Noa, Highland Europe, Brookfield, Mubadala, RXR Digital Ventures and Target Global. Headquartered in London with a global outlook, we're working towards managing over 2 million properties through our platform.

The Role

As Commercial AI Ops (GTM Engineer), you'll help change how Plentific's commercial teams work. You'll sit within the Strategy & Go-to-Market team and own the Commercial AI Hub end to end: the skills, automations and AI capabilities that Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and RevOps use every day.

The Commercial AI Hub is already live and in use. Your job is to scale it. That means prioritising the roadmap, turning business problems into clear requirements, building and shipping new capabilities, and driving adoption across the commercial organisation. You'll build most things yourself with low-code and AI-native tools. For integrations and larger projects, such as a shared commercial knowledge base or “second brain”, you'll design the solution and then - where required - work with IT and Engineering to deliver it.

Alongside the Hub, you'll support commercial leadership on target account prioritisation and sales outreach coordination, and help design and improve the commercial processes the team runs on.

This role suits someone who is commercially minded, structured in how they solve problems, and keen to learn how AI can change the way a B2B team sells and serves customers.

This role is based in London (hybrid).

Responsibilities

Commercial AI Hub Ownership

What we’re all about

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK’s fastest-growing technology companies, we’re on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions.

As we continue to grow globally, we’re looking for an ambitious and detail-oriented Finance Manager to join our Financial Reporting team, playing an important role in supporting accurate financial reporting across our growing international business.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision — people who are curious, collaborative and excited to make an impact. People like you.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of key areas of the reporting cycle, working across multiple entities to ensure accurate and timely financial information. You’ll bring strong technical accounting expertise, support robust financial controls and help identify opportunities to improve how we operate.

You’ll also work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, providing insight and guidance on financial matters and helping to ensure we have the right processes in place to support effective decision-making.

What You’ll Be Doing.

  • Support the Month-End: Play a key role in the month-end close alongside the Group Reporting team, owning accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations for your areas, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Lead Accounts Payable: Own the end-to-end accounts payable process, from supplier onboarding and invoice processing to payment runs, ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time with robust controls in place.

  • Own Project Accounting: Track the financial performance of specific initiatives, ensuring costs are captured, allocated and reported correctly, and providing clear insight to project stakeholders.

  • Manage Travel & Expenses: Oversee travel spend and the travel and expense systems used across the business, maintaining clear policies, driving compliance and identifying opportunities to control costs.

  • Strengthen Our Treasury Function: Contribute to the treasury function by building and maintaining cash flow models, producing cash reporting and forecasts, and managing our day-to-day banking relationships.

What You’ll Bring.

  • A professional accounting qualification (CIMA, ACCA or equivalent)

  • Proven experience in an operational finance role, with hands-on ownership of accounts payable, cash management and month-end processes.

  • Hands-on experience building cash flow models and forecasts, and working directly with banking partners.

  • Advanced Excel capabilities and experience tracking and reporting spend at a project or initiative level.

  • Experience managing and developing people and resources within an operational finance team, with excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Industry experience within a high-growth tech or SaaS company.

  • Experience implementing or managing travel and expense systems (e.g. Ramp, Navan or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems like NetSuite.

  • A track record of automating and improving AP, treasury or expense processes.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. raw.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

As Director of Revenue Enablement, you will lead the global enablement function across Sonar's go-to-market organisation, spanning Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations, you will own the strategy, programmes, and systems that shorten ramp time, lift quota attainment, and equip our GTM teams to sell a technical product into developer, platform, and security buyers. You will inherit a small enablement team and a strong foundation, and will scale it into a measurable, outcomes-driven function that supports Sonar's next phase of growth in the age of agent-centric development.


What you will do

  • Own the revenue enablement strategy: Define and execute a multi-year enablement roadmap aligned to Sonar's GTM priorities, with quarterly outcomes tied to ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment.

  • Lead a global enablement team: Manage and grow a team of enablement specialists across regions; set clear priorities, coach for excellence, and operate as a player-coach where required.

  • Design onboarding and ongoing readiness: Build role-based onboarding for Sales, CS, and Partner roles. Run continuous readiness programmes across product, process, messaging, and selling skills.

  • Equip teams for a technical buyer: Build playbooks, talk tracks, objection-handling guides, and competitive content tailored to developer, platform engineering, DevSecOps, and CISO audiences.

  • Drive GTM kick-off and major moments: Own the enablement track for Sonar's annual GTM kick-off (250+ attendees) and quarterly business reviews.

  • Modernise the enablement tech stack: Evaluate and operate the LMS, CMS, sales engagement, conversation intelligence, and AI tooling that power seller workflows. Drive adoption and measure impact.

  • Partner cross-functionally: Work with the CRO, VP Sales, VP CS, Product Marketing, Product, and Partner leaders to align messaging, qualification frameworks, and customer journey execution.

  • Measure what matters: Build dashboards and reporting that link enablement activity to GTM outcomes. Use data to prioritise investment and retire programmes that do not move the number.

  • Embed AI into the seller workflow: Bring a clear point of view on how AI tooling accelerates rep productivity, coaching, and deal execution at Sonar.


Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will:

  • Bring 10+ years in B2B SaaS revenue or sales enablement, including 4+ years leading a global enablement function.

  • Have a demonstrated track record of improving ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment through structured, measurable programmes.

  • Have enabled GTM teams selling a technical product to developer, platform engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or security buyers.

  • Have designed and run large-scale GTM kick-offs and enablement events for 250+ attendees.

  • Be hands-on with the modern enablement tech stack (LMS, CMS, sales engagement, conversation intelligence) and have integrated AI tooling into seller workflows.

  • Be fluent with at least one structured qualification framework (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or equivalent) and able to drive consistent adoption across the field.

  • Operate effectively with VP and C-level stakeholders, and bring strong written and facilitation skills.

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Be passionate about building inclusive, high-performing teams.

In-office Culture

 

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Account Director

Sparta Commodities is the next generation, AI-first commodity trading data platform. We are revolutionising energy commodity trading, delivering market intelligence that empowers traders and analysts across all energy verticals.

We’re looking for an Account Director to own some of Sparta’s largest and most important client relationships. You’ll have two jobs. First, protect the revenue: keep every account deeply engaged, from the traders and analysts using Sparta every day up to the most senior decision-makers, so that no renewal ever comes as a surprise. Second, and just as important, grow these accounts into $1M+ relationships. This is a true sales role. You’ll find the opportunities yourself, build the business case and lead senior-level conversations that move clients from limited user licences to enterprise-wide, unlimited-user agreements.

What You’ll Be Doing

Protect and deepen the relationship

  • Own a portfolio of Sparta’s largest and most strategic accounts as the senior commercial lead for each one.

  • Build relationships across the whole organisation, from day-to-day users on the trading desk to heads of trading, COOs and C-suite stakeholders.

  • Know every account well enough that renewals are never at risk by surprise. Track usage, engagement and stakeholder sentiment, and act early on any sign of risk.

  • Run executive business reviews that show the value Sparta delivers and agree with each client what success looks like next.

  • Work with Customer Success, Product and our analyst teams so every client gets full value from Sparta and their feedback shapes the product roadmap.

Grow accounts into $1M+ relationships

  • Build and execute a strategic account plan for every account, mapping desks, teams, regions and commodity verticals not yet using Sparta.
    Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities proactively, including additional products, verticals, desks and users.

  • Take conversations to the most senior level and lead strategic discussions about moving accounts from limited user licences to enterprise-level, unlimited-user agreements.

  • Use value selling to build the business case for enterprise adoption, showing how Sparta changes the way the whole organisation trades, analyses and makes decisions.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals from start to finish, including procurement, legal and commercial negotiation.

  • Consistently meet or beat retention, net revenue retention and expansion targets.

  • Keep account plans, renewals and expansion pipeline accurate and up to date in HubSpot, including MEDDPICC qualification and forecasting.

  • Coach and support Account Managers, sharing best practice on strategic account management.

About You

  • 8+ years’ experience growing existing and strategic accounts in B2B SaaS, financial data, market intelligence or commodities.

  • A proven record of expanding large accounts substantially, including taking accounts into seven-figure or enterprise-wide agreements.

  • The gravitas and credibility to lead conversations with very senior stakeholders, including heads of trading, COOs and C-suite executives, and to challenge their thinking with confidence.

  • Strong skills in value selling. You build the business case around the client’s outcomes, not product features, and can show how Sparta changes their operations at enterprise level.

  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise negotiations through procurement and legal.

  • Hands-on ownership of both retention and expansion. You run the renewal and close the growth yourself.

  • Strategic and commercially sharp, with the discipline to build and run long-term account plans.

  • Organised and data-driven, with strong CRM and forecasting habits and a working knowledge of AI tools.

  • Genuinely curious about commodities and energy markets.

Nice to Have Experience

  • Prior experience selling to trading houses, oil majors, refiners, banks or hedge funds.

  • Experience with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or another value-selling framework.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.

  • An additional European language.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

◆ Run at least one assay in the panel independently, including its controls and acceptance criteria.

◆ Revise one culture or assay protocol so that someone else could follow it without asking you.

◆ Hold the weekly assay schedule on your own and return results on the agreed turnaround.

◆ Bring one protocol to a tighter precision bar, or into a plate format ready for automation.

You are a hands-on cell biologist who takes assay variability personally. You have run the same assay often enough to tell a real effect from a bad plate, and you would rather find the cause than repeat the run.

raw.description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes.

As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. This is a hands-on bench role, and in a small team you will also support the work either side of production when it needs doing. Downstream, that means molecular characterisation runs. Alongside, it means the cell culture behind our cell-based assays, from routine passage and banking to seeding assay plates.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Run our core DNA preparation, cell-free expression and purification protocols to a

consistent standard.

◆ Learn how a sample is tracked, from DNA order to purified protein, and what gets

recorded at each step.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Take a full plate of constructs from DNA through expression, purification and QC with

minimal support.

◆ Support on one step beyond production, such as a downstream characterisation

readout, a mammalian expression run or routine culture for the cell-based assay panel.

◆ Revise one protocol, including how its failures are captured.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Run production week to week as part of the team, with QC results others can rely on

without checking.

◆ Own and routinely execute a downstream characterisation readout, a mammalian

expression route or maintenance of cell lines for a cell-based assay.

Who you are

You are a hands-on protein scientist who likes the bench and cares about doing the same thing well many times over. You have expressed and purified proteins yourself, you know what a failed prep looks like and why it failed, and you are comfortable working in plates rather than one tube at a time.

You keep records someone else could follow without asking you. You say early when something is not working, and you are happy with a plan that changes as we learn.

We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ A PhD in biochemistry, protein science, molecular biology or a related field (recent graduates welcome), or a BSc or MSc with two to three years of hands-on lab experience. Industry experience in a high-throughput setting is preferred.

◆ Molecular biology for expression: PCR, cloning by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and checking constructs by gel, fragment analysis or sequencing.

◆ Recombinant protein expression and purification you have run yourself, in at least one of cell-free, E. coli or mammalian systems, with affinity capture such as His, Strep or Protein A.

◆ Protein QC: quantification, SDS-PAGE or CE-SDS, and reading the results critically.

◆ Working in 96-well or 384-well plate formats, with careful, traceable record-keeping.

◆ Mammalian cell culture with good aseptic technique: adherent and suspension lines,

thawing, passaging and banking, and transient transfection of HEK293 or CHO cells for expression.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Protein characterisation: binding kinetics by SPR or BLI, or biophysical assays such as nanoDSF, DLS or analytical SEC.

◆ Cell-based assays such as reporter bioassays for binding or blockade, receptor internalisation or cytotoxicity, with imaging or flow cytometry readouts.

◆ Liquid handlers, magnetic-bead purification systems or other lab automation.

◆ Experience with antibodies, nanobodies or other binder formats.

Why this is unusual

Most protein production roles make a handful of proteins well for one project. This one makes many, in plates, for a lab built around the quality of its data, and that changes the job in two ways.

The record is part of the product. Every construct, lot, condition and QC result is captured as structured data, including the proteins that did not express, because a result is only as trustworthy as the material behind it. And the protocols you write become the starting point for automated workflows, so they have to be precise enough for a liquid handler to follow.

That means more documentation and more standardisation than most research labs ask for.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

How we work

This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The proteins are made in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench.

The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens in Slack rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

The team you will join

You will join the protein science team and report to a senior member of its scientific staff. Day to day you will work with the scientists running DNA supply, molecular characterisation and the cell-based assays downstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on.

We are a small, elite team, and the people in it make the calls in their own areas.

Our process

Our process has four stages. A short screening call about the role and the practicalities. A behavioural interview about how you work, run from the same template for every candidate, before anything technical. A technical stage with the protein science team, built on real work from our lab rather than a puzzle, in person at the lab. Then references, aimed at whatever we still want to understand.

If you are not sure whether you match every line above, apply anyway. We would rather read it and decide.

Enterprise Sales Executive, Manufacturing
raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As an Enterprise Sales Executive focused on Manufacturing vertical, you will open new doors for UiPath across a territory full of untapped potential. Your focus is winning new logos: finding, building and closing opportunities with manufacturers that have not yet worked with UiPath. You will engage C-suite leaders and digital transformation teams early, challenge how they think about work, and position UiPath as the trusted platform for agentic automation across production, supply chain, finance and customer operations. Every new customer you win helps manufacturers cut repetitive work, become more resilient and efficient, and free their people to focus on higher-value decisions and better outcomes. This is a high-impact hunting role in an industry going through major change. You’ll be challenged, supported and inspired by some of the best talent in the field as you build your own path to success.

What you’ll do at UiPath

  • Build and run a territory plan focused on new logo acquisition, identifying and prioritising the manufacturing organisations with the greatest potential

  • Generate your own pipeline through proactive outreach, including cold calling, social selling, events and executive networking

  • Break into new accounts and build relationships from first contact through to signed contract

  • Own the full sales cycle for new business, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close

  • Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual new business targets

  • Lead with insight, bringing a point of view on how automation can solve specific challenges such as supply chain disruption, order-to-cash delays, quality and compliance demands, and workforce shortages

  • Build compelling business cases that show the financial and operational value of UiPath to new buyers

  • Work with local partners and global systems integrators to source new opportunities and access new accounts

  • Partner with marketing, business development and pre-sales teams on campaigns and plays that create new pipeline

  • Track competitors, market trends and industry priorities to spot new opportunities before others do

  • Hand over new customers smoothly to Customer Success and Customer Engineering, setting them up for successful implementation and long-term growth

  • Share what works with fellow sales executives to strengthen the team’s hunting approach

  • Explore ways of incorporating automation into daily work

What you’ll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of solution or value selling experience, with a strong focus on new business

  • A proven track record of consistently winning new logos and exceeding new business quota year on year

  • 3+ years of enterprise sales experience selling to Manufacturing customers (preferred)

  • Experience building pipeline from scratch in a greenfield or under-penetrated territory

  • Confidence prospecting into senior stakeholders, including the C-suite, and opening conversations with organisations that are new to you and to UiPath

  • Understanding of manufacturing operations and the systems that support them, such as ERP, supply chain and shop-floor technology

  • Ability to explain new and complex concepts simply, in a way that creates real desire for the solution

  • Skill in navigating complex organisations and building a network of contacts across departments and levels of leadership

  • A research and data-driven approach to account targeting and planning

  • Resilience, persistence and a competitive drive to win

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, internally and externally

  • A self-starter who is invested in the success of the team

  • Bachelor’s degree highly preferred

  • Automation-first mindset

#LI-MB1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. raw.title: Principal Software Engineer
raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.

  • Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.

  • Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.

  • Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.

  • Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.

  • Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.

  • Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.

  • Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.

  • Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.

  • Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.

  • Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.

  • Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.

  • An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.

  • A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.

  • Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.

  • An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.

  • You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

raw.title: Head of Product Marketing Management  (London)
raw.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services. 

We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way. As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

Our values ✨

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

The team 🧑‍🤝‍🧑

UpSlide is a productivity platform for Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint, Excel and Word) built for financial professionals in investment banking, private equity, asset management and advisory. Product Marketing sits at the centre of Product, Sales and Marketing: we decide how UpSlide is positioned, priced and sold.

You'll join as our Head of Product Marketing, reporting directly to Matteo Bordin, our Chief Product Officer.

You'll manage one PMM and over time grow your team.

Day-to-day, you'll work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing leadership. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and still get into the work.

Team goals 🎯

Product Marketing's job is to make UpSlide easy to understand, easy to sell, and priced right. Concretely, that means:

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging so prospects grasp the value fast.

  • Arm Sales to win, especially against direct competitors.

  • Own pricing and packaging decisions and the reasoning behind them.

  • Run customer communications that drive adoption and expansion.

The impact on the business is direct: higher win rates, stronger pricing power, shorter sales cycles.

Your responsibilities 🖋️

Positioning & narrative (25%)

  • Own UpSlide's positioning and messaging across segments and personas.

  • Turn product capabilities into a clear story that resonates with financial professionals.

  • Keep messaging consistent across the website, sales materials and campaigns.

Sales enablement & competitive intelligence (25%)

  • Build the enablement that helps Sales qualify, pitch and close: decks, battlecards, objection handling and one-pagers.

  • Own competitive intelligence: track competitors, brief the business, keep our differentiation sharp.

  • Partner with Sales leadership on win/loss analysis and act on what it tells you.

Pricing & packaging (20%)

  • Own pricing and packaging: structure, tiers, and the logic behind them.

  • Run the analysis and make clear recommendations to the exec team.

  • Support Sales on deal-level pricing and commercial strategy.

Customer communications (15%)

  • Own how we communicate with customers: launches, releases and lifecycle comms.

  • Drive adoption and expansion through clear, well-timed messaging.

Team leadership (15%)

  • Lead, coach, and grow the PMM you’ll manage.

  • Set priorities and hold a high bar on output.

Your goals ⚡

First 3 months: Learn the product, customers and competitors in depth. Build relationships with Sales and Product. Audit our current positioning, pricing and enablement, and tell us where the gaps are.

By 6 months: Ship a refreshed positioning and messaging framework. Stand up a repeatable competitive intelligence rhythm. Deliver a first pricing and packaging recommendation.

By 9 months: Have an enablement program running that measurably improves win rates, pricing changes live or in flight, and a customer communications cadence the business relies on.

As UpSlide grows, this role can grow into broader marketing leadership. We'll back you to get there.


You are a great fit if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise B2B sales: you've either carried a quota in complex, high-value deals or worked hand in hand with sellers who do. This is a must.

  • A proven product marketing track record: positioning, messaging and sales enablement that moved the needle.

  • Experience owning or heavily influencing pricing and packaging decisions.

  • People leadership experience: you've managed and developed marketers.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and the judgement to write for an exec audience.

We'd love it if:

  • You've worked in or sold to financial services: investment banking, private equity, asset management, or advisory.

  • You know the Microsoft 365 / productivity software space.

  • You speak French (not mandatory)

✨ If you don't tick all the boxes but you think you'd be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  • First screening with our Talent Acquisition team (30 to 45 min, phone or video): mutual fit and motivation.

  • Manager interview with Matteo Bordin, CPO (45 min to 1h30, video or in person): product thinking and experience.

  • Peer interview with a peer from Product, Marketing, and Sales (~45 min).

  • Case study with Matteo and a Product peer (45 min to 1h30): a deeper problem worked through together.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive!

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: An inspiring eighth-floor corner office near Liverpool Street with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a balcony with a view, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: 3 days in-office per week

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

⏰ Flexi-work: Flex your schedule however works (e.g. bank hours across the fortnight to take a Friday off)

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: £45 per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈ Holidays: 25 days plus public holidays & a half-day of additional holiday per year of full service (up to 5 additional days)

🪙 Pension: Pension contributions (with matched contributions up to 5% after one year)

🩺 Health insurance: Opportunity to opt into a health insurance plan (Vitality)

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨
