raw.title: Senior Data Engineering Manager, AD/ADAS
raw.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

TEAM

At Woven by Toyota, we tackle Autonomy challenges at the intersection of AI, Robotics, and Advanced Driving. We develop advanced Perception and Planning technologies, and their production software for multiple AD/ADAS systems. To deliver reliable data-driven technologies to millions of Toyota vehicles, we are solving complex real-world problems using large-scale data, machine learning, and state-of-the-art architectures for Perception, Prediction, and Motion Planning.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The team is seeking an experienced, technical, and hands-on Autonomy Data Manager to grow and lead a talented team composed of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and ML Ops Engineers, working in the Autonomy team to deliver data driven Planning and Perception solutions. You will lead the team to drive the creation and deployment of sophisticated data models and algorithms to resolve business challenges for the Autonomy team. You lead through your expertise in data, deep learning and software engineering. You provide technical guidance to the team by combining modern data approaches with safety standards while also considering cost efficient options.. Furthermore, you are proactive towards handling the processes required for production development and approach them by asking "What can I do for you?" with a "Giver" mindset.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define the team's short-term and long-term technical direction while collaborating on broader, cross-functional strategic initiatives across Perception, Planning, Simulation, Infrastructure, and Tooling. 

  • Initiate and influence cross-functional teams towards common data development goals and unified solutions.

  • Support the data roadmap for the program and connect your team’s technical roadmap by focusing on actionable data strategy approaches from data collect strategies, to data curation, labelling , sampling, evaluation, with a goal of leveraging the large amounts of Toyota’s market fleet data to directly improve machine learning  model performance across the End-to-End Autonomy Data pipeline.

  • Lead initiative execution by defining efficient processes, mitigating technical risks, and anticipate long-term strategic improvements within the team and across the program.

  • Enable and develop each team member to be more effective through coaching and leading by example providing high-quality algorithms, carefully thought out design reviews, and delivering rigorous initiative reports.

  • Collaborate and provide technical guidance in the design, development, deployment, optimization, and evaluation of state‑of‑the‑art data algorithms, data efficiency and pipelines to enable ML model performance with a focus on iteration speed, scalability and overall cost efficiency.

  • Drive a culture of rigorous statistical evaluation to measure, validate and implement evaluation frameworks that support ML model development and improved system behavior.

  • Drive organizational metrics towards performance, safety, and quality.

  • Work in a high-velocity environment, employ agile development practices, and collaborate in a globally distributed department (US, Japan, UK).


    • MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Masters or PhD degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative fields, or equivalent industry experience

  • 3+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with a focus on technical leadership, team development, and delivering high-impact projects in the automotive industry.

  • 8+ years of experience covering data science, data sampling and curation, machine learning workflows, pre-processing, model training, ablation studies, evaluation, deployment, and inference optimization.

  • Experience with rigorous data science for applications leveraging large scale data sources and highly efficient pipelines

  • Experience working with large-scale robotics datasets, temporal data and/or sequential modeling

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate concepts clearly and precisely

  • Experience writing software using: i)  Python for data science (numpy, scipy, scikit, pandas; ii) databases; and iii) cloud platform services (AWS, GCP, Azure)


    • NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience as a Data Architect or Senior Manager

  • Proven track record of deploying ML models at scale in self-driving products, self-driving challenges, or related fields

  • Experience with production data pipelines or Safety & Quality processes for safety-critical applications

  • Hands-on experience in the following:

  • Analyze huge (e.g. peta byte) scale database;

  • Develop perception-related technologies, such as camera image processing, computer vision, machine learning, or deep learning; 

  • Design data annotation rules for machine learning

  • Build or manage infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

  • Behavior prediction, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or end-to-end models.

  • Japanese language skills

    • WHAT WE OFFER
    We are committed to creating a modern work environment that supports our employees and their loved ones. We offer many options of the best programs to allow you to do your most meaningful work and to help you shape the future of mobility.
    ・Excellent health, wellness, dental and vision coverage
    ・A rewarding pension
    ・Flexible vacation policy
    ・Family planning and care benefits

    Our Commitment
    ・We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.
    ・Any information we receive from you will be used only in the hiring and onboarding process. Please see our privacy notice for more details.

We are looking for software engineers who are excited to help build a state-of-the-art automotive platform that is “software first”. Our team is developing tools and systems using modern software techniques. We need software engineers who excel at building robust software systems to solve challenging problems at scale. 

The ideal candidate would have a considerable background in developing complex software with modern C++ over embedded systems.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Implement, deliver and refine Arene SDK software components for users to interact seamlessly with the vehicle systems

  • Design and implement abstraction layers to enable hardware-agnostic software platforms using modern C++ concepts

The Sensor & Calibration sub-team is seeking a Software Engineer to support the development of ground truth sensor calibration & data validation tools that live in the cloud and fuel our next-generation autonomous driving systems.

The selected candidate will be responsible for accelerating our calibration & data validation systems as well as maintaining & improving its infrastructure used across multiple teams. The scope of this role encompasses the following: (1) Developing and scaling validation pipelines that process large quantities of LiDAR data in the cloud, (2) Collaborating with hardware and data engineers to supporting sensor data validation across a complete sensor set up: cameras, LiDARs, imus & radars, by (3) Authoring SQL-based validation tests to ensure data correctness and coverage, (4) Managing the teams calibration and validation services, ensuring robust and predictable operation, and (5) Improving the maintainability, reliability, and observability of these systems, (6) Maintaining and improving the team repositories, with an emphasis on simplification and long-term code health, (7) Evolving the teams Vision library to be more extensible, enabling other engineering teams to build reliably on top of it. Furthermore, candidates who exhibit a collaborative, "giver" mindset, proactively supporting partner teams while maintaining a strong focus on production-quality, scalable solutions, are highly valued.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the design, implementation, and delivery of calibration & validation pipelines alongside its underlying infrastructure, proactively resolving deficiencies and ensuring that solutions meet objectives for reliability, maintainability, and business impact.

  • Write high-quality code & workflows that scale to process large quantities of fleet data, maintaining stable cloud-based calibration & validation services.

  • Contribute SQL-based validation tests and collaborate with hardware and data teams to ensure comprehensive sensor data validation coverage.

  • Enable other engineering teams to build reliably on top of shared infrastructure, improve and simplify our in house Vision library.

  • Instrument and monitor production systems, proactively identifying and addressing issues to uphold service reliability and observability.

  • Operate within a high-velocity environment and employ rigorous agile development practices

  • Work within a hybrid workspace model, necessitating physical presence in our London office three days per week.


    • MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's (Master's preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and modular code.

  • Experience building and maintaining cloud-based data pipelines, with a strong emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and scalability.

  • Experience managing and maintaining software repositories, including code reviews, dependency management, versioning, and enforcing contribution standards across multiple teams.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling to maintain and improve production service health.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and collaborate effectively across teams and disciplines, supported by excellent interpersonal skills.


    • NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, BigQuery, or similar) for cloud-based validation pipelines.

  • Familiarity with autonomous driving sensor modalities, particularly camera, LiDAR, IMU and/or Radar.

  • Prior contributions to shared platform or framework libraries used by multiple engineering teams, with an emphasis on developer experience and extensibility.

  • Experience managing or contributing to backfill and data reconciliation services in a production environment.

raw.title: Software Engineer - Data Infrastructure
raw.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

Team

Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. 

Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems.  We are a distributed team, working in the UK and US.

 

Who are we looking for?

The London Data Infrastructure team is looking for engineers who are passionate about and enable the next generation of automotive software development. The right candidate will have excellent communication skills, solid coding skills, broad knowledge of software development across areas such as Data Infrastructure and Warehouses, Data Ingestion, Compute Frameworks, Observability and Build Infra.


Responsibilities:

  • Work on high-impact projects and innovate new solutions to problems in the self-driving space.

  • Work with Computer Vision and Machine Learning engineers on high-impact projects and innovate new solutions to problems in the self-driving space.

  • Understand the complex data requirements of modern ML development and tailor our data ecosystem to these needs.

  • Build efficient data pipelines for ingestion from the vehicle fleet.

  • Work on distributed systems that serve, process and transform large quantities of data in the cloud.


    • Minimum Qualifications:

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Partner, Generalist
raw.description:
HELP BUILD THE TEAMS SCALING CUTTING-EDGE CONSTRUCTION TECHNOLOGY

At XYZ Reality we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our product, The Atom, is used on major projects worldwide to help construction teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

As a Series B business scaling across the UK, US and Europe, we're looking for an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner to help build the business teams behind our next stage of growth, from HR, Finance and Legal to Marketing, Commercial and leadership roles.

THE ROLE

You'll own hiring across a broad range of business functions globally, partnering with leaders across HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Commercial, and supporting leadership hires as we grow. You'll work alongside our Talent Acquisition Partner - Technology as part of a small, high-impact TA team, reporting to our Head of Talent Acquisition.

This isn't a role focused on processing applications. You'll proactively find and engage the strongest people in the market, many of whom aren't actively looking, and advise hiring managers on what great looks like, where to find it and how to secure it.

No two weeks will look the same. One week you might be mapping the market for a senior Finance hire, the next closing a Marketing role in Europe or helping a leader shape a brand-new team.

The role is based in our London office, a 5-minute walk from Angel station, on a hybrid basis.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own end-to-end hiring for business roles globally (brief → offer → close), up to and including leadership positions

  • Partner with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring plans, shape role profiles and challenge requirements where needed

  • Lead with direct sourcing, headhunting passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, networks, referrals and creative approaches

  • Run discreet, high-touch searches for senior and leadership hires

  • Manage hiring across multiple countries, navigating local markets, compensation and employment considerations

  • Lead offer negotiation and closing, advising on competitive packages

  • Coach hiring managers and interviewers on structured, inclusive assessment

  • Deliver a standout candidate experience from first touch to offer

  • Use data to improve hiring performance and processes, and reduce reliance on agencies

  • Provide market insight on salaries, talent trends and hiring strategy

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years' recruitment experience hiring across a broad range of business functions such as HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Commercial

  • Experience hiring senior and leadership roles

  • A strong direct sourcing track record. You go out and find great people rather than waiting for them to apply

  • Experience recruiting internationally across multiple countries

  • Strong stakeholder skills. You can challenge, influence and partner effectively with senior leaders

  • Comfortable managing a varied requisition load in a fast-paced, evolving environment, building process as you go

  • Familiarity with tools like Ashby ATS and LinkedIn Recruiter

Startup or scale-up experience, ideally at Series B or a similar stage, would be particularly valuable, as would in-house experience within a technology business or exposure to construction or construction technology.

Above all, we're looking for a recruiter who is proactive, commercially curious and energised by variety. Someone who enjoys partnering with leaders across the business and wants a genuine say in how we build our teams.

WHY JOIN US

🚀 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

🌍 Help build teams across the UK, US and Europe

🎯 Direct exposure to senior leadership and business-critical hires

🏝️ 25 days annual leave + public holidays

🩺 Private healthcare with Vitality

🎄Christmas shutdown days on top of leave allowance (2–4 per year usually)

🚇 Office located within a 5-minute walk from Angel station

🏠 Hybrid working

🪙 Biannual salary reviews

🥳 Summer & Christmas staff parties

🍣 Free lunch bought in and after-work gathering/drinks every Thursday in the office

💰 Employee referral scheme

· 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

Ready to help us build the teams behind our next stage of growth? If you're an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner who loves variety, leads with direct sourcing and wants real impact in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

If you'd like to see the products and technology we've created so far on our journey, you can view it in action through our YouTube and Website http://www.xyzreality.com/

raw.title: Ecosystem Manager, AI Materials Foundry
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid global growth and the launch of our AI Materials Foundry, we are seeking an AI Materials Foundry Ecosystem Manager to join our Partnerships team and report directly to our Director of Strategy & Operations.

Your Impact

In this role you will be engaging the global partner ecosystem that accelerates the adoption of our AI Materials platform, which is critical for delivering next-generation semiconductor and advanced materials to market.

 

Your main focus initially will be establishing an active cross-cultural foundry member community across our Europe, USA, and APAC hubs.

What You Will Do

Ecosystem Cultivation & Community Activation

  • Design, coordinate, and host a comprehensive global engagement strategy across our AI Materials Foundry including member engagement and events.

  • Build scalable partner collaboration frameworks.

  • Act as the primary operational bridge for tech partners, enterprise clients, and elite research institutions across Europe, the USA, and APAC.

Cross-Cultural Operations & Project Management

  • Manage day-to-day engagement with global foundry stakeholders.

  • Coordinate cross-functional timelines between external partner teams and CuspAI leadership.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Partner closely with our Director of Strategy & Operations and Head of Partnerships to align ecosystem activities with our overarching roadmap.

  • Collaborate with our AI Research, Computational Chemistry, and Product teams to channel partner feedback directly into the development priorities of our agentic platform.

  • Work alongside marketing and PR functions to spotlight partner success stories, such as dramatic speedups in simulation workloads and novel applications in advanced materials research.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You have a genuine, explicit interest in how frontier AI can revolutionize materials science and a passion for bringing sustainable, impactful technologies to humanity.

  • You possess a proven track record in ecosystem management, strategic alliances, or technical community building, ideally within a high-growth startup or fast-paced deep-tech environment, alongside substantial experience communicating and building relationships with executive-level stakeholders.

  • You have experience independently creating and managing events and conferences, owning them end to end, from concept through delivery. Including initiatives run alongside or on behalf of Fortune 100 companies.

  • You demonstrate extensive global cross-cultural experience, with a proven ability to engage and build trust with senior stakeholders across international borders (e.g. Europe, USA, APAC).

  • You are a confident, charismatic communicator with direct experience hosting, moderating, and organizing both virtual webinars and premium in-person events for a technical audience.

  • You have a solid foundational understanding of or proximity to the semiconductor ecosystem, hardware roadmaps, or advanced materials development.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct professional background working within a semiconductor foundry, design firm, or electronics materials supplier.

  • Native or professional fluency in a second language relevant to our global hubs (e.g. Japanese, Korean, German).

  • An academic background or deep personal literacy in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or Electrical Engineering.

  • Experience managing joint ecosystem programs alongside major hardware tech giants like NVIDIA or Meta.

Additional Considerations

This role would be based in our London/Cambridge offices or our U.S. Bay Area office, but we could consider our other global office locations for the right candidate. There would be an expectation around you being in the office three days per week depending on which projects you’re working on at the time. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner sites and/or other locations for collaboration and project work.

raw.title: Product Engineer
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a full-stack Product Engineer* to lead the inception and development of our internal application suite, serving as the foundational architect for the tools our world-class researchers use every day.

*Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the indicative job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role. The role will be part of our Platform Engineering organisation.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the internal product ecosystem that streamlines and curates our proprietary discovery workflows, which is critical for accelerating our mission to solve global challenges through next-generation materials.

Your main focus initially will be partnering with our VP of Product to define and build the first generation of internal applications from scratch, ensuring they are not just functional but curated as high-quality products. Over time, you will likely get involved in scaling these systems to support increasingly complex interdisciplinary data flows and potentially external-facing interfaces as our "search engine" for materials evolves.

What You Will Do

Product Inception & Internal Tooling

  • Lead the development of a suite of internal applications, treating them as first-class products with a focus on usability and long-term scalability.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Product to translate high-level research needs into technical roadmaps and intuitive software solutions.

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of internal tools, from initial architecture and backend design to frontend deployment.

Full-Stack Development & Platform Integration

  • Design and build robust backend services in Python to interface with our core AI and research engines, integrating disparate workflows into a unified, high-performance internal platform.

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure seamless ingestion and visualisation of complex datasets within internal applications.

  • Develop clean, responsive UIs that enable researchers to interact with complex data effectively, maintaining a high bar for intuitiveness and reducing cognitive load for technical users.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with AI Researchers and Data Engineers to understand the nuances of their daily tasks and build tools that empower them.

  • Collaborate with the broader engineering team to ensure internal tools align with our overall infrastructure and security standards.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You are proficient with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, or TypeScript) and have a keen eye for UI/UX best practices.

  • You are a "builder" at heart who enjoys the greenfield stage of a project and is comfortable making architectural decisions from scratch.

  • You have a product-focused mindset, meaning you don't just "write tickets" but actively think about how to make the user's life easier.

  • You are excited by the prospect of enabling world-changing scientific discovery, even if you don't have a background in the sciences yourself.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup environment where you've had to wear multiple hats.

  • Previous experience building internal tools, dashboards, or "Admin" interfaces for data-heavy companies.

  • Knowledge of modern DevOps practices and cloud infrastructure (e.g. GCP, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • An academic background or personal interest in Materials Science, Chemistry, or Sustainability.


Additional Considerations

raw.title: Director of Quality
raw.description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone, regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Dance in the customer's shoes; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1—guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Location: Remote or hybrid, EMEA or US Eastern time zone

Team: Production, Quality

Reports to: VP Production

Direct reports: Quality Manager (AMER, customer staffing) and 2 Quality Coordinators

About the role

As Director of Quality, you will own LILT's quality system end to end: standards, audit, compliance, procedures, continuous improvement, and the roadmap and operation of our Quality Agents. You'll help move Quality from a primarily reactive, execution-led function to a proactive, data-driven partner for customers and internal teams, with quality designed into our AI-native workflows.

You'll be the person who can run a customer audit while simultaneously shipping an improved agent evaluation. As the single Quality partner for Customer Success, Production, Research and Product, you'll turn customer requirements into measurable acceptance criteria, effective controls and better models and workflows. You'll advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix, including where automated, agent-verified and human-verified workflows are appropriate, with stronger assurance for high-risk and regulated content.

We're looking for a hands-on Quality SME and operator with real depth in both worlds: experience designing and building AI agents and improving LLM output, and a solid grounding in traditional quality management. You'll bring senior expertise in data, AI, customer advisory and process, and make sure quality work prevents recurrence rather than stopping at rework or ticket closure.

What you'll do

Quality Agent leadership

  • Evaluate, design and build reliable Quality Agents with well-defined tools and clear, structured instructions.

  • Use orchestration patterns to evolve from a single agent to multi-agent systems.

  • Define evaluation criteria, test sets and success metrics for agent performance, and run agents in production with clear monitoring and escalation paths.

  • Drive adoption across teams and show measurable reductions in manual quality effort.

Research and Product partnership

  • Work closely with Research and Product on ADQ, LLM model improvements, AI Review, AI QA, and new and emerging AI workflows.

  • Turn quality findings into product requirements, evaluation criteria and continuous feedback loops that improve model and workflow output.

  • Act as the voice of quality in roadmap discussions, and help decide where human review, AI review or both are needed.

Audit, compliance and procedure

  • Own LILT's approach to internal and external audits, including ISO certification (e.g. ISO 17100, ISO 18587, ISO 9001) and customer audits.

  • Plan and run periodic internal audits, manage evidence collection, and track corrective and preventive actions to closure.

  • Standardise and maintain SOPs, workflows and quality documentation, and keep them current as AI workflows change how we work.

  • Make sure quality processes meet customer, contractual and regulatory requirements.

Customer advisory

  • Partner with Customer Success and Delivery to define proactive quality programmes, success metrics and governance for strategic accounts, including AI-forward enterprise and life science / regulatory programmes.

  • Translate customer quality requirements into clear pre-delivery acceptance criteria, validation methods and risk-appropriate controls.

  • Advise customers on the right quality, cost and speed mix and where automated, agent-verified, human-verified or combined workflows are appropriate.

  • Represent LILT's quality function as a credible subject-matter authority in customer business reviews, audits and escalations, using quality data and metrics to demonstrate fitness for purpose.

Continuous improvement

  • Lead structured CI across the Commercial business: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, KPI reviews and retrospectives.

  • Own a proactive quality metrics framework that makes errors, PQs, rework and trends visible, and use it to prioritise improvements and demonstrate outcomes.

  • Strengthen quality controls across review, delivery and follow-through, including mandatory account-specific checks, intervention on critical findings and clear escalation ownership.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to automate checks and escalation, and verify that corrective actions prevent recurrence rather than ending at rework or ticket closure.

Expert Operations partnership

  • Partner with Expert Supply and Ops to embed processes, guidance and quality feedback that maintain a high-quality pipeline of experts.

  • Use quality findings and recurring failure patterns to improve expert qualification, guidance and ongoing quality management.

Team leadership

  • Lead and develop the Quality team, including the customer-facing Quality Manager and Quality Coordinators.

  • Establish the team's operating cadence and evolve how the team works as Quality Agents reduce manual coordination work.

  • Oversee embedded Quality Manager staffing sold as a service to customers, ensuring the role owns the specific quality programmes and initiatives those customers pay for.

  • Develop playbooks for AI-driven quality management and keep staffing-as-a-service delivery aligned with LILT's quality standards.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Agent design and build: demonstrable, hands-on experience designing, building and running LLM-based agents in production. Please be ready to walk us through agents you have built.

  • Data-driven quality management: scripting or data skills (e.g. Python, SQL), with experience turning quality data into actionable metrics, preventive controls and measurable improvements.

  • LLM model improvement: proven experience improving LLM output quality.

  • Significant experience running quality systems, including leading audits (internal and external), compliance programmes, and writing and maintaining processes and procedures. Quality certifications such as Six Sigma are a plus.

  • Experience leading structured CI (RCA, CAPA, KPI reviews).

  • Experience managing and developing people.

  • Customer advisory and cross-functional partnership: a clear communicator who can translate customer quality requirements into acceptance criteria and governance, advise on quality, cost and speed trade-offs, and work credibly with customers, executives and technical teams.

Nice to have

  • Background in localisation, translation or language services.

  • Experience in customer-facing quality roles for enterprise accounts.

  • Research and Product collaboration: a track record of working with research scientists and product managers to turn quality insight into product requirements and shipped improvements.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent

  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing

  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation

  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review


LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!

  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.

  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.

  • Check out all our news on our website.

raw.title: Sales Director, EMEA
raw.description:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Sales Director, EMEA

 

This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading.

 

As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success.

 

Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers.

  • Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities.

  • Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition.

  • Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships.

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable.

  • Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

  • Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events.

  • Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team.

 

Requirements

 

  • 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets.

  • An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe.

  • Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued.

  • The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms.

  • Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines.

Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second. We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

Our Commercial and Revenue Operations teams help power commercial growth by ensuring that customer-facing teams have the right knowledge, skills, processes, systems, data and capabilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive revenue.

As a Commercial & Revenue Operations Graduate, you’ll build a broad understanding of the commercial lifecycle while gaining hands-on experience in areas such as Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights and Business Partnering.

You may complete rotations across commercial teams before moving into a longer-term placement aligned with your strengths, development interests and business needs. The proposed early careers model includes Commercial Operations, BDR, Account Management and Solutions Engineering pathways.

You’ll work alongside experienced professionals, receive structured training and mentoring, and join a global Early Careers community with networking, professional development and leadership opportunities.

How you’ll make an impact

During the programme, you may:

  • Analyse commercial processes and workflows to identify bottlenecks, risks and opportunities to improve efficiency.

  • Support the design and implementation of scalable processes, playbooks and operating procedures.

  • Use data to identify trends, measure performance and provide clear recommendations to commercial stakeholders.

  • Help maintain accurate CRM and pipeline data, supporting reporting, forecasting and decision-making.

  • Support deal, pricing and approval processes, ensuring information is complete, accurate and well controlled.

  • Create enablement materials, training resources and communications that help commercial teams adopt new tools and ways of working.

  • Explore how AI and automation can improve commercial productivity and operational effectiveness.

  • Partner with teams including Sales, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Product, Engineering, Finance and Data.

  • Contribute to projects that improve the merchant experience and support sustainable revenue growth.

What we’re looking for

You’re a curious, organised and commercially minded problem-solver who enjoys connecting people, processes and data. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking questions and taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in a quantitative, business, economics, technology or similarly relevant subject.

  • An interest in commercial strategy, revenue operations, sales, fintech or business transformation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical recommendations. Intermediate to advanced spreadsheet ability. SQL is a plus.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail.

  • An appetite to learn about payments, technology and the commercial lifecycle.

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, data and new ways of working.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility for delivering outcomes.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Payments or financial services knowledge is helpful but not required.

  • A keenness to work at pace, managing competing properties effectively and maintaining quality while delivering against tight timelines

What success looks like

By the end of the programme, you will:

  • Understand how Checkout.com’s commercial teams operate and work together.

  • Be able to analyse a business process, identify improvement opportunities and recommend practical solutions.

  • Demonstrate confidence working with commercial data, systems and reporting.

  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and levels.

  • Deliver projects that create measurable value for commercial teams or customers.

  • Be ready to progress into a permanent role within Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights, Business Development, Account Management or another suitable commercial pathway.

Early Careers experience

You’ll receive:

  • Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training.

  • Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions.

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues.

  • Networking and community events.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects.

  • Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations.

  • Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements.

Our culture

We’re looking for people who put the customer first, move with pace, continuously improve, take ownership and maintain high standards of accuracy. Our early careers strategy is designed to develop future payments and commercial experts who can contribute with technical curiosity, commercial awareness and a merchant-focused mindset.

Eligibility

  • Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway.

  • Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme.

  • Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth.

Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership.

You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities.

  • Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements.

  • Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines.

  • Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data.

  • Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time.

Eligibility Requirements

This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care.

This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here.

  • Academic Qualifications: You will have either:

  • A degree qualification

    OR

  • You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date

+ 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths

Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway.

  • Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail.

  • Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you!

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

The role


We are scaling a high-impact Strategy & Operations team within the CEO Office to strengthen product delivery and execution across the business.

As a Manager, Strategy & Operations, you will be a hands-on operator embedded in a designated Product team or pillar. Working alongside Product, Engineering and other functions, you will lead complex strategic and operational initiatives, align stakeholders, manage dependencies, resolve blockers and drive delivery from planning through launch. This is a business execution and operating leadership role—not primarily a consulting or process-improvement role.

You will use data and first-principles thinking to identify root causes, design practical solutions and build scalable operating mechanisms. The role offers high visibility with the CEO and executive team, with opportunities to grow into broader responsibilities across Product, Technology and the wider organisation.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Drive strategic initiatives: Lead major cross-functional projects, create alignment, clarify ownership, manage risks and make sure initiatives launch effectively.

  • Build scalable operating mechanisms: Develop practical standards and processes for planning, testing, launch readiness, governance, reporting and cross-functional decision-making.

  • Improve measurable business outcomes: Take ownership of specific processes or metrics where there is a clear opportunity to improve speed, quality or scalability.

Success means owning and delivering meaningful business projects—not simply diagnosing problems or redesigning processes in isolation. You will build trust with your Product team or pillar, take ownership of strategic initiatives and turn ambiguous priorities into clear, measurable plans that drive delivery through launch.

You may come from strategy consulting, investment banking, product, technology, operations, professional services or a high-growth company. raw.description:
Company Description

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Description
As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lease Administration & Governance

  • Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data.

  • Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements.

  • Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken.

  • For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations.

  • Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval.

  • Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams.

2. Financial and Procurement Reporting

  • Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools.

  • Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head.

  • Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations.

  • Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords).

3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation

  • Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements.

  • Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information.

  • Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements.

4. Departmental Administrative Support

  • Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials).

  • Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement.

  • Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions.

  • Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models).

  • Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control.

  • Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness.

  • Schedule and prepare agendas, collate pre-read materials, and document meeting minutes for key real estate governance forums, proactively tracking action items to ensure timely closure by stakeholders.

  • Managing the administrative aspects of the "joiner/leaver" process for office access where no assigned Workplace / People person is assigned.

  • Act as the primary administrator for processing property-related invoices, performing the initial "first-pass" review to flag discrepancies against purchase orders (POs) and ensuring all costs are accurately coded before final submission to Finance.

5. Health, Safety & Physical Security Management

  • Coordinate the global H&S audit schedule in partnership with SMEs, managing the central audit database, evidence library, action log, and training records to track progress and compliance.

  • Support the weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting framework to surface risk trends and audit completion status, allocating audits to regional teams for execution.

  • Own the scheduling, chasing, and evidence trail for the audit lifecycle, acting as the primary administrative point of contact to ensure smooth execution.

  • Drive the audit lifecycle by ensuring all actions are identified, triaged, and managed to resolution, proactively identifying blockers and managing overdue items.

  • Ensure regional teams interpret and apply the central H&S framework in accordance with local laws while maintaining the global baseline standards.

  • Manage the integration of the H&S framework with wider Real Estate RACI to ensure clear accountability and prevent overlaps in responsibilities.

  • Implement and maintain physical security policies and standards across all global office locations.

  • Instruct periodic physical security risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security protocols.

  • Oversee visitor management processes and physical security measures to safeguard personnel and assets.

Additional Information

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are seeking a TPRM Senior Associate with 4+ years of relevant experience to serve as a key operational member of the London TPRM team. This role is the primary operational bridge between the London leadership, the Offshore TPRM Operations Team, and critical onshore functions (Procurement, Business Owners, Risk SMEs). The Senior Associate is responsible for coordinating the execution workflow, managing the quality assurance of medium-risk third parties, and driving the logistics for the critical Supplier Performance Review process.

Responsibilities

This role is centred on execution quality, operational leadership, and cross-functional coordination within the London TPRM team structure:

  • Offshore Operations Liaison & Quality Control:

    • Act as the primary daily point of contact and operational supervisor for the Offshore TPRM Operations Team, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all third-party risk assessments and due diligence activities.

    • Lead the Quality Control (QC) process for all assessments delivered by the offshore team, ensuring outputs are consistent, align with established methodologies, and are fully audit-ready.

    • Monitor the operational performance of the offshore team against defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

    • Be ready to conduct third-party assessments to support the team, where required.

  • Stakeholder Coordination & Assessment Oversight:

    • Coordinate Assessment Initiation by working closely with Procurement and Business Owners to ensure third-party risk assessments are initiated at the correct phase of the third-party lifecycle.

    • Manage the crucial triage and review process by coordinating with Internal Risk SMEs (e.g., InfoSec, Data Privacy, BCP) to ensure high-risk assessments receive appropriate specialized review and sign-off prior to completion.

    • Serve as the operational point of contact for these onshore internal risk teams regarding third-party-specific findings and remediation requirements.

  • Supplier Performance Monitoring & Reporting:

    • Oversee the governance and standardization of ongoing supplier performance monitoring activities executed by the offshore team.

    • Coordinate with Business Owners and Procurement to collect and review performance data (e.g., SLA adherence, operational metrics) and integrate significant performance failures or deficiencies into the overall third-party risk profile.

    • Ensure any critical performance issues are appropriately flagged for risk review and incorporated into continuous monitoring plans.

  • Escalation and Remediation Management:

    • Serve as the primary escalation point for all high-risk findings, process bottlenecks, and third-party non-compliance issues reported by the Offshore TPRM Operations Team.

    • Work with Business Owners and Procurement to define, drive, and track third-party remediation plans, ensuring mitigation steps are completed within established timelines.

  • 2nd Line of Defense Liaison & Governance Support:

    • Act as the key operational liaison for the 2nd Line of Defense (Risk Oversight), compiling and delivering required operational data, metrics, and commentary on the coverage and control effectiveness of the TPRM program.

    • Support the TPRM team in the preparation of reports and presentations on TPRM metrics, trends, and program effectiveness for leadership and Risk Committees.

  • Program & Tool Support:

    • Assist the TPRM team in the implementation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of the TPRM system/tool, ensuring data integrity across the platform.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of dedicated experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), risk management, compliance, or a related operational control function.

  • Consulting Background: Prior experience working at a Big 4 (e.g., Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG) or a similar major consulting firm is highly desirable.

  • Operational Control: Proven experience acting as a process gatekeeper or reviewer, with specific experience in Quality Assurance (QA) for risk or compliance deliverables.

  • Coordination: Demonstrated success coordinating delivery and information flow between offshore/remote teams and demanding onshore business/risk stakeholders.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage expectations and articulate complex operational risks clearly.

  • TPRM/GRC Knowledge: Solid understanding of TPRM principles, risk domains (InfoSec, BCP, ABAC, etc.), and prior experience supporting the administration or maintenance of a GRC/TPRM platform is highly desirable.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

The ideal candidate will need to be an independent, high-achieving individual, able to stand out in an entrepreneurial environment and outperform sales targets through personal drive.

 

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Pipeline Growth: Identify the most promising clients and grow a healthy pipeline for card issuing across various verticals.

  • Solution Selling: Sell our issuing products to travel intermediaries and fintech clients through outbound techniques.

  • Consultative Expert: Help prospects evaluate Checkout.com, handling detailed questions about our product capabilities, serving as a consultant and industry expert.

  • Proposal Management: Prepare thorough presentations and proposals that highlight the ROI of switching to a modern issuer.

  • Full Cycle Orchestration: Lead the entire Sales process, acting as the main point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Collaboration: Partner with other Sales team members to share best practices, key business insights and industry trends

  • Market Intelligence: Provide feedback on local trends including competitor insights, customer needs, sales, product and marketing information

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of Sales experience, with at least 3 years specifically within Payments or Card Issuing.

  • Network: A solid network of potential prospects and partners.

  • Business Acumen: Solid understanding of financial factors, including interchange mechanics and card scheme products.

Our mission is to enable businesses and their communities to thrive in the digital economy. We’re the strategic payments partner for some of the best known fast-moving brands globally such as Wise, Hut Group, Sony Electronics, Homebase, Henkel, Klarna and many others. Purpose-built with performance and scalability in mind, our flexible cloud-based payments platform helps global enterprises launch new products and create experiences customers love. And it's not just what we build that makes us different. It's how.

And we’re just getting started. We’re building diverse and inclusive teams around the world — because that’s how we create even better experiences for our merchants and our partners.

Role overview | Context

In this role, you will play a key part in delivering, optimising, and continuously evolving the London office experience across our UK operations.

You will own critical operational areas, driving performance through data and ensuring the workplace operates with precision, accountability, and consistency. Acting as a link between strategy and execution, you will translate workplace priorities into scalable processes, measurable outcomes, and high quality day to day experiences.

You will take ownership across workplace operations, vendor management, reporting, and governance, with the autonomy to make decisions and lead on key initiatives.

This is a high impact role suited to someone who thrives in fast paced environments, brings a strong analytical mindset, and is motivated by raising the bar for workplace experience and operational excellence.

You will take a customer first approach to every interaction, proactively understanding employee and visitor needs, resolving issues through to completion, and using insight and data to continuously improve the workplace experience.


Role overview | Remit and Responsibilities

Amongst other duties, this role will be primarily responsible for the below.

Operational Leadership & Delivery

  • Own day to day workplace operations, ensuring the office runs smoothly, safely, and consistently while delivering a seamless employee and visitor experience.

  • Act as a visible and trusted on site point of contact, ensuring workplace spaces, services, and touchpoints are well maintained, well stocked, and delivered to a high standard.

  • Conduct regular workplace walkthroughs to identify, resolve, and escalate issues before they affect employees or visitors, maintaining consistently high standards across presentation, safety, functionality, and hospitality.

  • Drive operational excellence through strong execution, accountability, and continuous improvement across all Workplace activities.

  • Lead and support workplace initiatives, aligning delivery with Workplace strategy, business needs, and opportunities to enhance the day to day employee experience and operational efficiency.

Financial Management

  • Own the UK Workplace budget end to end, including tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost optimisation

  • Lead procurement, PO management, and invoicing processes with accuracy and efficiency

  • Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to resolve issues and improve processes

  • Manage vendor commercials, including pricing negotiations and contract renewals

Vendor & Contract Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key vendors and site partners, including building management, cleaning and maintenance providers, acting as the primary point of contact for day-to-day operational matters.

  • Proactively manage supplier communication, ensuring expectations are clear, issues are resolved promptly, and services are delivered consistently to agreed standards.

  • Drive day to day vendor performance by monitoring service levels, holding suppliers accountable, providing regular feedback, and escalating risks or recurring issues where appropriate.

  • Support contract management by maintaining accurate supplier records, tracking key dates and renewals, and coordinating contract administration.

  • Identify opportunities to improve supplier performance, service delivery, and operational efficiency through regular reviews, performance reporting, and ongoing collaboration.

Data, Reporting & Performance

  • Own Workplace reporting frameworks, dashboards, and KPI tracking

  • Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting across budget, operations, and workplace experience metrics

  • Combine operational data, service usage, employee feedback, and qualitative insight to identify trends, prioritise improvements, and measure the impact of changes on the employee experience.

  • Track service performance measures including employee satisfaction, response and resolution times, service usage, recurring issues, and supplier performance; communicate outcomes and actions clearly to stakeholders.

  • Ensure team accountability to reporting standards and performance metrics

Stakeholder & Site Operations

  • Supporting engagement with building management (e.g. CBRE), ensuring issue tracking, resolution, and accountability

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships across People, Finance, and wider business teams including senior leadership

Compliance & Sustainability

  • Own Workplace compliance and reporting obligations (e.g. SECR, ESOS, energy reporting)

  • Ensure alignment with regulatory, environmental, and company standards

  • Drive improvements in sustainability performance

Workplace Experience & Projects

  • Oversee experience led services (e.g. Food & Beverage), ensuring quality, consistency, and cost control

  • Partner with Workplace Coordinator(s) to deliver an exceptional day to day employee experience

  • Lead Workplace projects end to end and implement scalable process improvements

  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance workplace experience and operational efficiency

  • Build a sense of community through thoughtful workplace activations, local events, welcome moments, and connection opportunities that respond to employee needs and reinforce Checkout’s culture.

  • Gather employee feedback through regular informal engagement, surveys, and service touchpoints, ensuring concerns are acknowledged, resolved, and closed out with clear communication.

Requirements:

  • Experience in a workplace, operations, or culture experience role, ideally within a fast paced environment

  • A customer first, hospitality minded approach, with the ability to build trusted relationships and create positive, personalised employee and visitor experiences.

  • Proven ability to own and manage operational functions, not just support them

  • Strong financial acumen, with experience in budget management, forecasting, and cost control

  • Confidence coordinating suppliers across hard and soft facilities management, responding to building issues, and escalating technical or compliance matters appropriately.

  • Experience managing vendors and contracts, with a strong understanding of SLAs and performance management

  • Highly data driven mindset, with the ability to translate insights into action

  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, confident working across all levels

  • Ability to operate autonomously, take ownership, and make decisions with confidence

  • A proactive, solutions focused approach with a drive for continuous improvement

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Highly self-sufficient and proactive, with sound judgement, a strong sense of ownership, and the ability to identify priorities and deliver solutions with minimal direction.
