raw.title: Accreditation Manager
raw.description:
Accreditation Manager

Build the processes that let Calibre expand into its next standard - and make every launch

easier than the last.

London, Aldgate East | 5 days in office | Start ASAP

£40,000-£60,000 + 0.1%-0.3% equity | 2-5 years' experience

Build a new kind of certification company

AI is changing how companies work. They still need independent assurance that their systems can be trusted.

Calibre is building a global certification business for that world, combining rigorous assessment with AI-powered operations.

Founded by two former Palantir engineers and backed by a $3.3m pre-seed round, we are starting with information security and expanding into AI management systems and further ISO standards. You will work directly with the founders to build the policies, processes and evidence that make that expansion possible.

What you will own

You will be the hands-on execution owner for new accreditation programmes, with an initial focus on ISO 42001 and expansion into other ISO standards. Gautham, CEO will manage you, and you will report directly to the founders.

- Write the substance. Translate standards and accreditation requirements into clear policies, procedures, responsibilities and records that reflect how Calibre actually operates.

- Find gaps and close them. Run and coordinate internal audits of Calibre's own systems, with appropriate independence and technical support. Identify missing evidence, test whether processes work, and build or improve them when they do not.

- Carry the accreditation process through. Maintain the requirements map and evidence trail; coordinate specialists, accreditation bodies and assessments; track findings, corrective actions and deadlines through to closure.

- Make the work compound. Turn each programme into reusable templates, clause mappings, evidence libraries, AI workflows and quality checks. Improve these with every assessment, then apply them to the next standard.

Support will be provided by our founders, technical specialists and commercial team, with commercial handoffs where needed. You will own making the work happen and ensuring it stands up to scrutiny.

What success looks like

A working set of internal processes that gives us confidence the next standard will be faster to add than the last: clearer requirements, stronger evidence, less repeated work and fewer avoidable gaps, while preserving the rigour of each assessment.

Rigour. Ownership. Good judgment with AI.

Who we are looking for

- 2-5 years of experience in consulting, clinical trials or medical device certification processes. You have learned to navigate complex requirements, demanding reviews and work where details matter.

- Strong writing and structured thinking. You can turn an ambiguous requirement into a precise policy, a workable process and evidence that it is being followed. You can explain and defend what you have written.

- A record of getting things finished. You have personally delivered complex work, coordinated stakeholders and resolved gaps. You follow up, raise blockers early and create a process when one is missing.

- Practical AI fluency. You are comfortable working with Codex, Claude Code or equivalent agents on substantive tasks and building reusable workflows around them.

Knowing when to stop using AI is essential

We want someone who knows where AI helps, how to give it useful context and how to verify its work against the source. Just as importantly, you must recognise when it is adding noise, missing the point or weakening the writing - and stop using it, think the problem through and write the answer yourself. You remain accountable for every output.

Experience with ISO management systems, internal audits, accreditation assessments, external assessors or workflow automation would be useful. Deep knowledge of every standard is not expected; the ability to learn carefully and execute is.

Why join Calibre

- Work directly with the founders on a central part of the business, with substantial ownership and visible impact.

- Build capability that lasts. Your policies and workflows will become the foundation for expansion across standards, with scope to grow as the business grows.

- £40,000-£60,000 salary and 0.1%-0.3% equity.

- 22 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

We work together in our Aldgate East, London office five days a week. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible. Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK; this role does not offer visa sponsorship.

raw.title: Product Engineer
raw.description:
About the job

About Calibre

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

The institutions and processes we rely on to provide that confidence were built for a slower, more predictable world. AI is advancing faster than the mechanisms we use to trust it.

Calibre is building trust for the AI era as the first AI-native certification body. We develop core technologies to understand AI and cybersecurity risk, and use them to independently assess companies against leading standards.

Founded by two ex-Palantir technical co-founders, and a founding team spanning audit and AI research, we are pushing the frontier of what trust looks like for the AI economy. We’ve raised $3.3M from top tier SF based VCs.

 

The Role

We are hiring a genuinely exceptional Product Engineer to join the founding team and build a new class of products to supercharge our AI-native certification process.

 

This person is language-agnostic, obsesses over first principles, and has already integrated LLMs into their daily workflow as a true force multiplier.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own products across the whole stack. Build and ship high-quality, high-velocity code across the full stack (front-end, back-end, and AI-agent infrastructure)

  • Build products end-to-end. Design systems from discovery through to production.

  • Engineer reliable agent systems. Design harnesses, evals and safeguards that make quality non-compromisable.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable AI engineering depth. You can show real systems where you made substantive decisions about agent harnesses, evals, hallucination containment, performance, agent sandboxing or MCP/tool design.

  • Strong product engineering and technical judgment. You ship across interface, backend, data and deployment, reason from first principles and choose tools deliberately.

  • Product instinct and clear collaboration. You ask good questions, form a view, test quickly, communicate clearly and care whether the work changes outcomes.

  • Evidence of exceptional output. Show us professional work, open-source contributions, personal products, research or hackathon results. Roughly 2+ years of experience is useful, but evidence matters more than tenure.

 

The Ideal Candidate

  • Exceptional technical talent with more than 1 year of professional experience. Your GitHub, personal projects, or hackathon wins speak for themselves.

  • A first-principles problem solver. You have a fundamentally strong computer science background (e.g., from a top university or equivalent experience) and are language-agnostic, picking the right tool for the job.

  • AI-Native: You are already a sophisticated user of LLM tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, etc.) for coding. You understand their strengths, weaknesses, and how to build systems that leverage them effectively.

  • High-Leverage & High-Output: You thrive in a high-pressure, high-growth environment. You understand that in an early-stage startup, precision and speed are paramount.

 

Compensation: £60K – £150K • 0.25% – 1%

About the Role

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. This isn't a role for someone who wants to execute instructions in isolation. We want someone who understands the commercial context behind what they're building — and who takes ownership of making sure it actually works for the people using it.

What You'll Do

CRM Administration & Development

– Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

– Assist in building, testing, and documenting automation workflows, lifecycle stages, and custom data structures

– Act as a reliable point of contact for CRM-related queries from market teams, escalating where needed and closing the loop on issues

Reporting & Market Intelligence

– Build and maintain dashboards and reports in HubSpot to support sales leadership and country managers across all 14 markets

– Translate reporting requests into structured, actionable outputs — not just visualisations, but insights that inform decisions

– Monitor data health proactively and flag inconsistencies before they compound

Revenue Operations — Marketing to Customer Success

– Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of processes that span the full commercial funnel — from marketing acquisition through sales pipeline management to customer success handoffs

– Help ensure that tools, data flows, and operational logic work coherently across functions, reducing friction and improving visibility at every stage

– Contribute to ICP qualification frameworks, segmentation models, lead management logic, and pipeline hygiene practices

– Collaborate with internal IT to support integrations between internal systems and the broader commercial toolstack, helping bridge technical and business requirements

Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

– Work alongside sales, marketing, customer success, and IT stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into operational solutions

– Communicate clearly across functions and markets — managing expectations, flagging dependencies, and keeping the right people informed

– Represent the RevOps function as a reliable, solutions-oriented partner rather than a bottleneck

Training Materials & Process Documentation

– Develop clear, structured training materials covering tools, processes, and operational frameworks — ensuring teams across all markets have what they need to work effectively

– Maintain process and system documentation as a living resource, updated as workflows evolve

– Work across our training infrastructure (including Supered and Sana) to publish and distribute materials to the right audiences

– Identify knowledge gaps through stakeholder engagement and translate them into practical, usable guidance

What We're Looking For

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

Nice to Have

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

What We Offer

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

  • Designing and building production-grade ML/software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. raw.title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
raw.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

Research questions you could initially work on

  • Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

  • Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

  • Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

  • Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

Your main responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

  • Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

  • Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

  • Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

  • Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

  • Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

  • Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research.

  • Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding.

What a great fit looks like

  • A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning.

  • Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research.

  • Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.

  • An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

  • A strong interest in climate mitigation.

You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does.

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.

Every email and notification we send is part of how customers experience Lendable, and a 5.0★ Trustpilot rating across more than 100,000 reviews sets a high bar for it: communication has to be clear, timely and honest. As our Senior Product Manager for CRM & Growth, you'll own the products and systems that shape how customers hear from us across their lifecycle, from first interaction through to retention and reactivation.

Product here isn't backlog grooming. The trade-offs are commercial as much as they are user-facing: engagement, retention, conversion, cost to serve and customer experience all pull against each other, and you'll make the calls.   • Treating email deliverability and messaging reliability as product concerns, working with Engineering on infrastructure, platform integrations and cost efficiency

  • Shaping requirements with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Risk and Compliance so that what we ship is effective and meets the standards expected of a regulated lender

  • Holding a high bar for what customers receive: clear, honest content, well-tested design, and rigorous checks before and after launch.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • 5+ years in product management, with substantial experience in CRM, lifecycle, messaging or growth for a consumer product at meaningful scale

  • Strong product management fundamentals: you've taken a product or channel from problem definition through launch and iteration, and owned both the product and the technical sides of delivery

  • Excellent prioritisation: a clear, defensible way of ranking competing opportunities by expected impact, effort and risk, the confidence to say no, and the ability to explain trade-offs to stakeholders

  • A track record of owning measurable outcomes in engagement, retention or revenue, not just shipping features

  • Strong SQL and analytical skills, and experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, with the habit of measuring impact rigorously rather than relying on vanity metrics

  • Enough technical depth to work credibly with engineers on messaging infrastructure, deliverability and platform integrations, and clear communication across technical and commercial audiences

  • Experience in financial services or another regulated industry

  • Experience launching a new channel or capability end to end, such as push notifications across mobile and web

  • Experience building experimentation or measurement tooling, including getting CRM and messaging data into a BI environment for analysis

  • Experience mentoring other product managers or CRM specialists

Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

What You’ll Do

  • Build AI workflow automation. Design, build and ship AI-powered workflows that remove manual GTM work; from lead research and CRM enrichment to call analysis, personalised outreach and lifecycle automation. Own builds end to end, from problem definition through deployment, monitoring and iteration.

  • Bridge gaps between systems. Find creative ways to connect tools that do not natively integrate. Build the webhooks, middleware, scripts and glue that keep data flowing cleanly between Salesforce and the rest of the stack.

  • Solve multi-departmental integration challenges. Work across the boundaries of Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Data and Finance to turn tangled, cross-functional processes into reliable, automated systems.

  • Prototype, test and scale. Test new ideas at small scale, measure what works, and scale the versions that deliver. Bring a bias to ship a working prototype over a perfect specification.

  • Build with AI as the default. Use LLMs, agentic workflows, MCP builds and evals as everyday tools. Ask “how would AI do this?” before reaching for headcount or manual effort.

  • Own reliability. Treat what you build as production systems: instrument them, monitor them, handle failure gracefully, and reduce risk across the GTM tech stack.

  • Evaluate and recommend. Run structured pilots of new tools, assess capability, integration fit, reliability and ROI, and make clear build-versus-buy recommendations.

  • Set the standard. Document what you build, enable GTM teams to adopt it with confidence, and mentor others in the team on building with AI and automation.

What You’ll Bring

  • Significant hands-on experience in RevOps, GTM Systems, or Sales Operations within enterprise technology, ideally in a structured qualification environment such as MEDDPICC. You understand the full GTM engine and you know what good looks like when real revenue depends on the systems you own.

  • Solid data and systems fundamentals. You understand CRM data models, object relationships, data quality and reporting architecture, and you design builds that keep data clean and trustworthy at scale.

  • A track record of building for internal GTM teams. Your strongest work is systems and workflows used every day by sales, marketing or CS teams inside a business, not only side projects, single-client builds or customer-facing pre-sales work.

  • A builder’s mindset on top of that foundation. You have built things, not just configured them. You can point to workflows, automations, integrations or tools you shipped that moved a real metric, ideally things nobody explicitly asked you to build.

  • You learn systems fast. You pick up unfamiliar platforms quickly and reason about how they fit together. You are comfortable reading API documentation, handling authentication, respecting rate limits, and parsing JSON when a native connector does not exist.

  • Fluency with AI as a build material. Hands-on experience using LLMs, agentic workflows, prompt design and evals to build systems you can trust in production, not just as an end user.

  • Comfort across low-code and code. You build with whatever fits the problem, from orchestration tools and Salesforce Flows through to scripting in Python, JavaScript, SOQL or SQL where it earns its place.

  • Cross-functional range. You can interview a top rep to find the manual work that should not exist, translate a business problem into a technical build, and explain the result in plain language.

  • Bias to ship, balanced with judgement. You move fast and decisively, and you build things others can maintain rather than sticky-plaster fixes.

  • Deep CRM knowledge. Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, or deep expertise in a comparable enterprise CRM. Certifications are welcome but experience matters more.

Beneficial, But Not Required

  • Experience with traditional GTM third-party tooling such as Gong, LeanData, Lusha, Cognism, Clay, Floqer, Zapier, Tableau, Snowflake, Guru, or equivalents.

  • Evidence of experimenting with AI beyond your day job, such as side projects or personal builds that show how you think.

How You’ll Work: Our Operating Principles

  • Solve for Customer Value. Define the customer problem and the value of solving it before you build.

  • Drivers, Not Passengers. Take ownership and accountability, and bring others with you.

  • Be Decisive, Even in Ambiguity. Speed is the strategy. Act with velocity over total certainty.

  • AI to Deliver Outcomes. AI is our engine, not an add-on.

Benefits

Senior Partner Marketing Manager
raw.description:
Our Purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

About this role

We're looking for a driven Partner Marketing Manager to deliver Planday's partner led growth motion across the UK and Europe.

You'll plan and run campaigns with integration partners and affiliates, turning our partner ecosystem into a measurable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll work closely with Partnerships, Sales, Product, and RevOps. You'll own delivery of partner marketing programmes, working within the strategy and framework set by the Head of Partner Marketing.

Partner programme delivery

  • Deliver the partner marketing plan for your partners, in line with regional GTM and growth objectives.

  • Run the Planday partner programme day to day, from planning and activation to measurement and optimisation.

  • Work with Partnerships, Sales, Product, and RevOps to keep partner activity tied to referral, pipeline and revenue goals.

  • Identify gaps, risks, and ideas to improve the programme, and feed them back into the wider strategy.

Integration partner marketing

  • Plan and run joint campaigns with integration partners, such as payroll, POS, accounting, and software partners.

  • Deliver joint marketing activity, including webinars, content, case studies, and in market events, to generate awareness and qualified referrals.

  • Report regularly on partner sourced and partner influenced pipeline, showing each partner's contribution to revenue.

Affiliate growth and enablement

  • Run and grow the marketing supported affiliate lead generation programme, so it delivers consistent, high quality leads.

  • Deliver campaigns to recruit, engage, and activate affiliates, and give them the tools and content to succeed.

  • Work with RevOps to make sure affiliate tracking, attribution, and reporting are accurate.

  • Test new channels and creative approaches to improve affiliate performance and ROI.

Performance and optimisation

  • Track campaign results and share insights to improve performance and partner collaboration.

  • Trial new joint marketing formats and incentives to increase engagement and conversions.

  • Report regularly on pipeline contribution, partner engagement, and ROI.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Experience: 4+ years in B2B marketing, including 2+ years in partner or ecosystem marketing within SaaS or technology.

  • Delivery: A track record of running joint marketing and affiliate programmes from brief to results.

  • Planning: Ability to turn a clear strategy and business goals into campaign plans with measurable outcomes.

  • Collaboration: Skilled at working with Sales, Product, Partnerships, and RevOps to get things done.

  • Data: Confident using data to guide decisions, improve campaigns, and explain results.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills, and comfortable presenting to partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Tools: Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation platforms (SFMC), affiliate software, and analytics tools.

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

raw.title: Head of SEO
raw.description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

We're hiring for a Head of SEO to own organic search presence across our iGaming and Rewards propositions in the UK and US. This is a build role: you'll set the strategy, hire the team and put the tooling and processes in place to execute.

You'll turn organic search into a predictable, compliant growth channel measured on commercial outcomes, not just rankings. That means registrations, FTDs and revenue for iGaming, and sign-ups and active members for Rewards.

You'll look after four sites: cashback.co.uk, joincustard.co.uk, strikewild.co.uk and slotswise.com.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and ownership

  • Set and own the organic search strategy for iGaming and Rewards across the UK and US, with clear targets and a 12-month roadmap

  • Prioritise by commercial value: focus effort on the verticals, states, merchants and page types that drive FTDs, revenue and member growth

  • Own the SEO budget and make the case for investment in people, tools, content and links

  • Work closely with commercial, paid, CRM, brand and compliance teams so SEO priorities match merchant deals and launch plans

Building the team

  • Hire and lead a team from scratch, starting with the roles the roadmap needs most (for example, technical SEO, content SEO, outreach)

  • Decide what to build in-house and what to outsource, and manage agencies and freelancers where it makes sense

  • Set the processes, playbooks and tooling the team runs on

Technical SEO

  • Own site health across our properties: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data and internal linking

  • Work with product and engineering to put SEO into templates, releases and migrations from the start

  • Build scalable page frameworks for reviews, comparisons, offers and state or market landing pages

Content and authority

  • Set the content strategy and editorial standards, with E-E-A-T and YMYL expectations built in

  • Lead a safe, sustainable approach to digital PR and link acquisition in competitive, closely watched SERPs

  • Shape our approach to AI-powered search, AI Overviews and generative engine optimisation (GEO) so our brands are cited and trusted

Markets and compliance

  • Run distinct UK and US plans that reflect each market's regulation, search behaviour and competition

  • Plan US state launches so content and authority are ready ahead of go-live

  • Make sure every page meets UKGC, ASA/CAP, US state and responsible gambling requirements

Measurement

  • Build reporting that links organic traffic to clickouts, registrations, FTDs and revenue

  • Track rankings, share of voice and competitor movement, and act on what the data shows

  • Report performance and forecasts to the leadership team

About You

Essential

  • 8+ years in SEO, with at least 3 years leading SEO strategy and people

  • A track record of growing organic revenue in iGaming, affiliate or another highly competitive, regulated vertical

  • Hands-on depth in technical SEO, and the credibility to work as a peer with engineering

  • Experience hiring and building a team, or a clear plan for how you'd do it

  • Working knowledge of UK and US gambling regulation and what it means for content and marketing

  • Deep understanding and practical application of AI, GEO and the impact on organic search visibility

  • Commercial sense: you can forecast, build a business case and tie your work to revenue

  • Strong command of the core toolset, for example Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and BigQuery or SQL

  • Clear communication with senior, commercial and technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Experience launching in newly regulated US states

  • Background in rewards, cashback, loyalty or comparison sites

  • Experience with programmatic or templated SEO at scale

  • Experience running site migrations or consolidations

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Bupa)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

raw.title: Sales Lead
raw.description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As a Sales Lead at Scarlet you will lead a team of Account Executives in London, grow that team, as well as continue closing deals yourself. You will own your team's quarterly number and the pipeline behind it. Our sales team has grown fast and is about to grow faster so we'll need your help to continue to build the team and develop our talent.

You will carry a personal quota alongside your team target, which will be reduced as your team grows, so you stay close to customers and lead from live deals rather than from a dashboard. The deals are technical: you are selling certification to regulatory, quality and clinical leaders at AI and software medical device companies, and you will need to build deep knowledge of EU MDR, ISO 13485 and other medical device certifications. Our best salespeople know the product in depth, and we expect the same of you.

You will work day to day with our leadership team, Business Development Reps, Commercial Relations and Customer Experience. This is a full-time, in-office role in London where your team will also be located. You will be in front of customers across the UK and Europe, including at industry conferences and Scarlet-hosted events.

Responsibilities

  • Own your team's quarterly target and forecast. Run weekly pipeline reviews, inspect deals, and call commits accurately.

  • Coach AEs on their deals: join discovery and negotiation calls, review call recordings and give feedback, and work with AEs to map decision-makers, budget and signing process on every deal.

  • Hire AEs to grow your team: screen candidates, run interviews, make hiring decisions, and onboard them to set them up for success.

  • Practice what you preach: source, run and close your own deals with regulatory, quality and clinical leaders at AI and software medical device companies.

  • Share what works: write up deal learnings and losses for the wider sales team, and bring improvements to the playbook, qualification and pricing conversations.

  • Work with the BDR team on first-meeting-to-discovery conversion and with Commercial Relations on partner and consultant referrals.

  • Represent Scarlet with your team at industry conferences (for example MEDICA, RSNA) and at Scarlet-hosted events.

Required qualifications

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a quota-carrying Account Executive owning full-cycle deals

  • At least 1 year managing or formally leading quota-carrying salespeople, with responsibility for their targets

  • A track record of hitting or exceeding quota as an individual contributor, including in the year before you moved into management

  • Experience hiring salespeople: screening, interviewing and making hiring decisions

  • Experience selling a technical or expertise-led product to specialist buyers, with deal cycles of three months or more and multiple stakeholders

  • Experience running pipeline reviews and forecasting a team or territory number to senior leadership

  • Able to show how you have coached an underperforming AE back to target, with the evidence you used

  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, London, with the right to work in the UK

Preferred qualifications

  • A STEM degree or equivalent technical background

  • Experience in selling to regulated industries

  • Experience as an early sales hire or first sales manager at a startup, where you helped build the process rather than inherit it

  • Experience selling into European markets outside the UK

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this role is £100,000 – £120,000 per year, with on-target earnings of £200,000 – £240,000. The actual base salary offered will depend on experience and skills. This role also includes equity in Scarlet and a competitive benefits package.

Interview process

We typically collapse interviews 3 to 6 into one in-person session in London.

  1. Intro call with James A - 30 mins

  2. Interview with Karan or Val - 30 mins

  3. Live case with Dan - 45 mins

  4. Interview with James A - 30 mins

  5. Interview with James - 30 mins

  6. Interview with Jamie - 30 mins

  7. Referencing, including at least one former direct report

  8. Offer

Compensation: £200K – £240K • Offers Equity

raw.description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

We’re hiring a Commercial Counsel to be a core member of Sierra’s legal team. We are looking for someone who has deep expertise in commercial contracts, but also someone who is eager to broaden their scope across IP, regulatory, and product. You will thrive in dynamic environments, enjoy tackling challenges beyond your comfort zone, and be excited to contribute across the business. In return, we’ll provide the support and opportunities you need to grow and excel as a lawyer. You’ll be part of a legal team that is highly respected within both the company and the broader legal industry—committed to excellence, collaboration, and making a meaningful impact.

  • Commercial Contracting: Structure, negotiate, and advise on all commercial contracts, including SaaS subscription agreements, technology licenses, professional services agreements, channel partner agreements, vendor agreements, and NDAs. Commercial privacy and security contracting experience (e.g., DPAs, BAAs, security agreements) is a plus.

  • Operational Excellence: Help build out our commercial function to be best-in-class. We aim to be the fastest and strongest, where the legal team is the differentiator in the contract lifecycle. You will be developing templates, playbooks, and workflows to drive efficiency and scalability.

  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of practice areas that underpin the commercial practice, including contract law, IP and privacy. You will also want to work in AI and understand the nuances of law as it relates to AI, including the evolving regulatory frameworks. You will be expected to advise broadly on all contractual issues and be comfortable doing so.

  • Teamwork: A team player first and foremost. Sierra is a unique place to work, with a strong sense of togetherness, and the legal team is no exception. You will look out for your colleagues and be accustomed to sharing and helping the team succeed.

  • Judgment: Understand risk in the context of a hyperscaling business, have sound judgment, and be strategic in your decision-making. You will not be afraid to make judgment calls, and you will be empowered to do so.

  • Approach: A strong work ethic with an eye for detail. You will strive for perfection and expect that of others.

  • Collaborate: Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, and Agent Development teams to support revenue growth and strategic business initiatives.

What you’ll bring

  • 2-6 years of legal experience, with a combination of both large law firm and in-house experience at a tech company.

  • A strong background in negotiating and managing complex commercial contracts, preferably in SaaS, AI, or enterprise software.

  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written) and the ability to partner with both legal and non-legal stakeholders.

  • A proactive mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment.

Even better…

  • Experience of privacy/regulatory frameworks and can advise on data processing agreements and security-related contract provisions.

  • Non-English languages, especially Spanish, German and French.

  • A passion for AI, with a deep understanding of AI products, LLMs and the related legal issues.

  • Law firm experience at a top-tier, internationally recognized law firm.

  • Experience working at a high-growth startup and operating with a sense of ownership.

  • Industry specific knowledge in any of the following: Financial Services, Healthcare, Telecoms, Insurance and/or Consumer.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

Compensation: £180K – £200K • Offers Equity

raw.title: Performance Engineer
raw.description:
UK | Full-Time

The Mission: Source.dev

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

We operate with a high degree of trust and a shared value of End-to-End Ownership:

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On

  • System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

  • Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

  • Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

  • Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

  • Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

  • Impact-Driven: You embody the "Own It" mentality - you see a friction point in the developer journey and you don’t stop until it’s gone.

  • Curious & Collaborative: You enjoy translating real-world customer problems into robust, production-grade solutions.

  • Low Ego, High Impact: Beyond being a brilliant coder, you are a thoughtful and empathetic teammate - someone who leads with kindness

  • Feedback Culture Champion: You embrace feedback and provide it thoughtfully; you see open, honest communication as the foundation of great teamwork.

 

A Note on Our Search

We are looking for the best talent, wherever it may be. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a perfect fit, please do apply - we value diverse backgrounds and unique problem-solving approaches.

Why Join Source.dev?

  • AI-Native Infrastructure: We merge deep systems expertise with AI to solve the "impossible" - using AI to automate complex merges and conflict resolution for the next generation of devices.

  • Architect the Future: Have a direct, visible impact on the infrastructure used to build the world’s most advanced hardware.

  • Early-Stage Ownership: You’ll have a seat at the table to shape our technical roadmap, product direction, and culture from day one.

  • Tier-One Partnerships: Work side-by-side with world-class customers, from global automotive giants to leading cloud providers.

  • Elite Engineering Culture: Join a high-trust & passionate team of engineers

raw.description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We're hiring two account managers in London to retain and grow Watershed's customers across northern Europe. We're at an inflection point: large companies across the region are launching and scaling sustainability programmes as regulatory and investor pressure builds every day. You'll do whatever it takes to make sure those companies are successful, happy, and continuing with Watershed. As founding members of our first account management team in Europe, you'll help build the renewal and expansion playbook for the region, shape Watershed's product, and help us build a stellar team.

You will:

  • Own and grow a book of enterprise customers. Work with the right people across each account, educate them about effective sustainability programmes, and help them drive continuous improvement and business value with Watershed. You'll own the full commercial relationship after the sale, from onboarding through renewal and expansion.

  • Build the renewal and expansion playbook for northern Europe. How do we best position new products to our customers? What's the best risk mitigation strategy? Where can we build stronger connections across key stakeholders? You'll turn the answers into a repeatable machine.

  • Shape Watershed's product, packaging, and go-to-market strategy for new products by sharing feedback from customers on the front line.

  • Become an expert in sustainability, and educate companies on how to navigate regulatory reporting (including CSRD), carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonising their supply chains.

  • Help build the account management team in Europe.

You might be a fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of sales or account management excellence, especially with enterprise customers (10,000+ employees) at an executive level.

  • Have 3+ years of demonstrated success selling, renewing, and expanding enterprise SaaS at €100K-500K deal sizes.

  • Have managed enterprise accounts across northern Europe and know how buying decisions, procurement, and stakeholder dynamics work in the region.

  • Are excited to lead from zero to one. You love to build things from scratch: new playbooks for navigating organisations and new ways to tell the Watershed story.

  • Are an excellent consultative seller. You listen deeply to customers and excel by helping them solve their problems.

  • Love going deep on new domains. You've sold products in complex or technical fields, and relish becoming an expert on your subject matter. You're voraciously curious. You're excited to learn everything about sustainability and help companies navigate this space.

  • Have a track record of doing whatever it takes to get things done. You've accomplished things that others thought were impossible. You're relentlessly resourceful.

  • Want to join a startup, take responsibility for the fate of the company, and move fast.

The role might include up to 20% travel across northern europe.

Must be willing to work from our London office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
